basic_info.description: This is quintessential San Francisco living at it's absolute finest! This stunning 1907 post earthquake Craftsman home was completely reimagined in 2017 as part of a boutique four unit association. Nestled in a prime location of Russian Hill with easy walking to Hyde Street restaurants and Polk Street amenities this is the most desirable and designer done of the four homes w/privacy, at the end of a reclaimed brick walkway + has peek-a-boo views. This quiet sanctuary is a turn-key property with 3 bedrooms, 3 baths and a luxurious den/family room. The great room features cathedral ceilings, Heath Ceramic detail on the gas fireplace, verdant outlooks, abundant wine storage and a private step-out deck for BBQ. The stylish kitchen features Miele appliances, Sub Zero refrigerator, large island and a dumbwaiter to the garage. There is a chic powder room on this level as well. Upstairs is a private primary suite with San Francisco views and a private en-suite bath. The lower level has a built-in office area, fun family room with a door to a private walkway, 2 bedrooms - one with a large en-suite bath with double sinks and abundant storage. There are internal stairs to the extraordinary, bunker-like garage with large private storage and 2 car parking. Enjoy the best of Russian Hill!
